title: Best Street Photography Camera (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by reviewing the product mentions in the supplied sources: pc‑mag, cnet, rtings, and accessorytested. Products appearing in more than one source were prioritized.
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price caveats are included.

verdict.line: Picture a busy city street and a photographer who needs a small, fast camera that still delivers high‑quality images. The X100VI offers a compact body, fast autofocus, and excellent image quality, making it ideal for street work. Its main catch is that it has a fixed lens, so you cannot change focal lengths.
